critical_code_review_comments: Diff vs onboarding-profile.before-blue-border.tsx shows targeted border implementation changes only: added SVG Rect stroke outline, per-card measured size, transparent native border; card internals/layout/CTA/background/functions untouched.
New border SVG is non-intercepting (pointerEvents='none') and uses stroke-only Rect with fill='none'; no blue fill surface introduced.
Gradient IDs are unique per card (onboarding-profile-name-card-reflection, onboarding-profile-gender-card-reflection, onboarding-profile-age-card-reflection), avoiding defs collisions.
No code evidence of external neon glow added to cards; runtime computed box-shadow for the three cards is 'none'.
